::: {.home-intro}
I build and use modelling and optimisation tools for energy systems. I also write about technical questions that arise from this work.

I have worked on modelling low-carbon energy systems since 2011. I currently work on energy systems modelling at the OECD Nuclear Energy Agency. Previously, I worked as an energy systems modelling engineer at Terra Praxis and as a research engineer at CEA, where I focused on modelling nuclear fuel cycle scenarios and industrial decarbonisation.

## Open-source projects

### Energy systems optimisation

- [Nosy.jl](https://github.com/oecd-nea/Nosy.jl): composable, component-based energy system modelling and optimisation toolkit. Maturity: used in production, including at the OECD Nuclear Energy Agency.
- [EnergyPathway.jl](https://github.com/GKrivtchik/EnergyPathway.jl): capacity expansion pathway layer built on top of Nosy.jl. Maturity: prototype.

### Nuclear fuel modelling

- [NuclearFuelScenario.jl](https://github.com/GKrivtchik/NuclearFuelScenario.jl): small and fast nuclear fuel model for supply chain analysis. Maturity: experimental, but already used for analysis.
